notes.title: Update, minor changes
notes.content:
We've updated "Deeply Dark: Found footage" by fixing some compatibility issues and details, among other minor changes.

If you are interested in the project, remember to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/heJRbzkU4d]Discord[/url]

notes.title: "Deeply Dark: Found Footage" officially released
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of "Deeply Dark: Found footage" on the Steam platform.

[previewyoutube=IGZ9FP0isHw;full][/previewyoutube]

We do not want anyone to be left out of this experience, that is why we will maintain free access to the software.

There is still material to reveal for "Deeply Dark: Found footage", we have implemented a system so that players can immortalize messages and support the project and in this way accelerate the release of the content.

Thank you for being as interested in this as we are, together we will discover the horrible mysteries that "Deeply Dark: Found Footage" holds.

For more information join our [url=https://discord.gg/heJRbzkU4d]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Deeply Dark free for everyone
notes.content:
After a long journey in which Deeply Dark has gone through numerous tests and changes, we believe that the best thing we can do so that more people know about it is to make it free.

The official launch will be on October 31, 2023.

After the official launch we will incorporate a donation system to support the project, anyone who has already purchased Deeply Dark in the past will be recognized in this system and will obtain the corresponding credits.

We greatly appreciate everyone's support, if you want to know more about us or the project you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/heJRbzkU4d]Discord[/url].
